Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

is

is, ea, id

pronoun: genitive ejus, dative eī; plural eī (iī), eae, ea

he, him (she, it); she, her (feminine ea); that, the one (just mentioned); the one who, the … that

In this lexicon

  • he

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 40.21.2: cupīdō eum cēperat in verticem Haemī montis ascendendī; Cic. Tusc. 5.108: cujātem sē esse dīceret

  • she

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.9.1: certum sciō jam convaluisse eam

  • that

    also used · classical · Cic. Amic. 80: est enim is quī est tamquam alter īdem; Ter. Ad. 978: Ob eam rem? — Ob eam.

  • the

    also used · classical · Cic. Amic. 80: is quī est tamquam alter īdem; Hor. Epod. 2.1: beātus ille quī procul negōtiīs
